subject: Charged twice this month!!
body: I just checked my bank statement and I was charged $49.99 TWICE for my monthly subscription on the 1st. This is the second time this has happened. I want a refund immediately or I'm cancelling and disputing with my bank.

subject: App crashes when I upload a PDF
body: Hi team, every time I try to upload a PDF larger than 10MB in the web app, the page freezes and then shows 'Something went wrong'. I'm on Chrome 130, Windows 11. Console shows a 500 error from /api/upload. Started happening yesterday.

subject: Do you offer student discounts?
body: Hello! I'm a university student and I'm interested in your Pro plan. Do you have any discount for students? Thanks in advance.

subject: URGENT: Production is down for all our users
body: Our entire team (200+ people) cannot log in since 9:15 AM. We get 'Authentication service unavailable'. We are losing money every minute. Please escalate to an engineer NOW.

subject: How do I change my email address?
body: Hi, I changed jobs and need to update the email on my account from my old work address to my personal one. I can't find where to do that in settings. Could you point me in the right direction? No rush.

subject: Invoice shows wrong company name
body: Our latest invoice (INV-20931) lists 'Acme Ltd' but our legal name is 'Acme Logistics Pvt Ltd'. We need a corrected invoice for our accounts department before the end of the month for tax filing.

subject: Would love dark mode
body: Love the product, honestly use it daily! One small thing: any plans for a dark mode? My eyes would thank you at night. Keep up the great work :)
